Menu

The Harris County Clerk Office's Elections Department and its annex locations are open to the public to distribute and receive voter registration forms and applications, vote by mail applications, and assist with other needs related to voting and elections.

Contact us with questions about vote by mail applications, ADA compliance, and with questions about elections.
